title: Geometry - Lesson 7 Assessment: Interior and Exterior Angles
description: Show mastery of adjacent interior and exterior angle relationships by writing equations and solving missing measures.

questions.question: A polygon has an interior angle of 126 degrees. A side is extended to form the adjacent exterior angle. What is the exterior angle?
questions.explanation: Adjacent interior and exterior angles add to 180 degrees, so 180 - 126 = 54.

questions.question: An adjacent exterior angle is 28 degrees. Find the interior angle beside it. Enter just the number.
Which statement correctly describes an adjacent interior and exterior angle pair?
options: They form a linear pair and add to 180 degrees.
They are never connected to the same vertex.
questions.explanation: The interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle share a vertex and form a straight line, so they are supplementary.

questions.question: An exterior angle is formed by extending a side of a polygon.
questions.explanation: Extending one side past a vertex creates the outside angle called an exterior angle.

questions.question: Solve for x: 118 + x = 180. Enter just the number.
The adjacent exterior angle of a polygon is 102 degrees. Which equation can be used to find the interior angle x?
questions.explanation: The interior angle and adjacent exterior angle are supplementary, so x + 102 = 180.

questions.question: At a polygon vertex, the interior angle is 3 times the adjacent exterior angle. Find the exterior angle. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: Let the exterior angle be x. The interior angle is 3x, so 3x + x = 180. Then 4x = 180 and x = 45.

questions.question: Which pair could be an adjacent interior and exterior angle pair at one polygon vertex?
questions.explanation: Adjacent interior and exterior angles must add to 180 degrees. Only 84 + 96 = 180.

questions.question: Explain why an interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle are supplementary.
questions.correctAnswer: They share a vertex and one side, and the other sides lie on a straight line because a side of the polygon was extended. Together they form a straight angle of 180 degrees, so they are supplementary.
questions.explanation: A complete answer should mention the side extension, the linear pair, and the total of 180 degrees.

questions.question: An exterior angle is 67 degrees. Write an equation for the adjacent interior angle x and solve it.
questions.explanation: Use the supplementary relationship for adjacent interior and exterior angles. Subtract 67 from 180 to get 113.
